How to Install Red Light (Fen Light Fork Debrid) Kodi Android Firestick

on May 20, 2026

This is a fork of Fen Lite from the Red Repo. No revoking of Trakt or TMDb keys, no 3rd party app blocking, no politics, no drama. Their Telegram group can be found here. This is a friendly group for all add-ons/builds from their repo.

Add-on offers: Movies, TV Shows, Anime, a wide range of adjustable settings, Trakt/Debrid integration

It does require a [TorBox account] or a [Debrid account].

Below is a guide for installing the Red Light add-on for Kodi this is a fork of the Fen Lite add-on which the dev has now decided to stop working on. This is a 3rd party add-on so please do not post questions about this add-on in the official Kodi forums. Just use the Telegram group above.

If you are installing an add-on for the first time or installing on a fresh install of Kodi you need to turn on Unknown Sources instructions follow this paragraph. If you have already turned it on then just [Jump to the guide]

  • Open Kodi
  • Select Settings (cog icon top left)

  • Select System

  • Scroll down to Add-ons and move to the right and click on Unknown sources

  • You will see a popup warning about giving access. Click Yes

  • Now go back and click on Updates

  • Change Install updates automatically to Notifiy, but don`t install updates (this means you can see when updates are available and update the ones you want)

How to Install Red Light for Kodi on Firestick or Android Device:

  • Go to the Kodi home screen & select Settings (cog icon top left)

  • Select File Manager

  • Select Add Source

  • Select None

  • Type the following EXACTLY https://repo.redwizard.xyzand then highlight the box underneath marked Enter a name for this media source, type red then click OK

  • Click back on your remote/keyboard
  • Select Add-ons

  • Select Install from zip file

  • Select red (or whatever you named it)

  • Select repository.redwizard.x.x.x.zip

  • Wait for the Add-on enabled notification
  • Select Install from Repository

  • Select The Red Repo

  • Select Video add-ons

  • Select Red Light

  • Select Install

  • Select OK if necessary
  • Wait for Add-on installed notification
  • Now you need to click back to go back one screen and select Program Add-Ons

  • Now select Gears Scrapers

  • Select Install and wait for installation complete notification

To setup scrapers and Debrid services

  • Open Red Light
  • Select Tools

  • Select Settings

  • Select Sources Accounts

  • Select Enable in External Scrapers

  • Select Choose External Scrapers Module

  • Select Gears Scrapers

  • Click OK when installed

  • Now authorise whichever debrid service you use

  • Select OK when confirmed

  • If using RD or AD I would enable Check for Cached Status...

There's a shed load more of settings in there that you can play around with to get it looking and playing like you want.
